creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-11-10 from the linked-pair notice fix (8f4a5f4b). A maker on another machine counts as busy whatever its hooks do, because the peer Member does not say whether its hooks fetch messages mid-turn, so a hooked maker elsewhere is told at its turn's end where a local one is told mid-turn. Needs a daemon protocol addition.
title: Say over the peer link whether a member's hooks fetch messages mid-turn
